ultrarare_occurrence.evidence_class: prospective preregistered species-layer support within one geography
ultrarare_occurrence.interpretation: exact observed island adjacency contains heldout presence information beyond the source-aware R3 reference

aggregate_balance_v1_122.corrected_interpretation: aggregate graph-pressure contributions are more evenly distributed among observed sources than matched random placements; this is not by itself spatial complementarity

target_space_turnover_v1_181.conclusion: distributed source-territory irreplaceability is not supported; observed source influence is more overlapping and locally less dominated than matched random placements

ecological_synthesis.core: the coordinate-built kNN operator has frozen heldout predictive information for range-map-derived island occurrence labels; it has not been shown to infer contemporary extant source populations, dispersal, colonization or rescue
ecological_synthesis.key_nonobvious_boundary: shared polygon-derived geographic label construction and occasionally historically restored presences may explain part of the graph signal; independent species-by-island checklist validation is needed
ecological_synthesis.structural_pattern: observed ultrarare source sets combine relatively balanced aggregate contribution with greater-than-random local co-coverage and lower-than-random source-identity turnover across target islands
ecological_synthesis.mechanism_removed: the v1.119 topology signal should not be explained as a set of distinct, individually irreplaceable source territories
ecological_synthesis.mechanism_remaining: the topology signal is compatible with collective configuration or overlapping source-neighborhood structure; no causal dispersal mechanism is established

independent_temporal_boundary.interpretation: static source-network information is not validated as later demographic consequence

primary_next_step: response-opaque crosswalk/eligibility audit for Hébert 204-island independent checklist dataset; stop if exact name-island support inadequate; hold ecology-mechanism GEB submission

constructed_graph_semantics.graph: coordinate-derived symmetrized kNN with minimum connected region-specific k, not measured animal movement
constructed_graph_semantics.heldout_topology_claim: geographic kNN graph better than degree-/edge-length-bin-rewired surrogates

response_semantics.label_type: curated IUCN-2017 mammal range polygons overlapped with GADM island polygons, manually corrected and partly augmented for historically extinct native species
response_semantics.originally_quoted_realized_presence_shou: positive cell in curated range-overlap/augmented matrix
response_semantics.original_richness_comparison: source authors reported independent regional richness correlation about 0.95±0.05; species-by-island independent accuracy not established by this aggregate
